## Example 4.4 {#iv4-example-4-4 .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson }

<p>Find the distance between the points <span data-math="A(-2,3,1)"></span> and <span data-math="B(4,-1,6)"></span>, giving your answer in exact form.</p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="\overrightarrow{AB}=(4-(-2),\,-1-3,\,6-1)=(6,-4,5)"></span></div><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="AB=\sqrt{6^2+(-4)^2+5^2}=\boxed{\sqrt{77}}"></span></div></div></div>
<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 4.4 · p. 28</div>

::: notes
Answer sqrt(77). First calculate the vector (6,-4,5), then its scalar length. Let students do the calculation before the check. Exact form is required.
:::
